headline: Amazon's robotaxi company Zoox has leased two more warehouses in Hayward, California, more than doubling its space around its existing robotaxi factory.
score_reason: Hints at expansion of robotaxi production, but only a lease and Zoox would not say how the space will be used.
importance_line: Bay Area workers and robotaxi riders may see more Zoox vehicles in time, but a lease is not a production plan and Zoox declined to give specifics.
summary: The San Francisco Chronicle reports exclusively that Zoox, the robotaxi company owned by Amazon, has leased two warehouses of more than 350,000 square feet in Hayward, California, near its 220,000-square-foot factory that can assemble up to 10,000 robotaxis a year. A Zoox spokesperson said the space will help it scale its purpose-built robotaxi fleet but declined to say how it will be used.
notes: Real-estate deal; no machine in action.
